reasoning: batch 1: Independent inspection of the unchanged panel.png found one eligible series, CO2 195K, drawn as blue open circles with a solid line. The red open-circle N2 77K series is excluded. The main plot frame is approximately x=128..661 and y=68..497 px within the 707x624 panel; the inset at about x=250..520, y=174..390 is not part of the main-panel extraction. Axes are linear: Relative Pressure (P/P0) runs 0..1 and Uptake runs 0..140 cm3 g-1. Tick positions independently agree with the supplied calibration (x about 484 px per unit and y about 2.86 px per uptake unit; residuals are sub-pixel to about 0.6 px). I reviewed the complete 48-row CO2 proposal and the native tile/box evidence before candidate overlays. The visible main-panel CO2 centres are generally supported, including crowded partially fused rings. I did not apply an edit: the dense-strip unresolved region contains connected blue ink and white ring fragments, but no additional separable centre can be located with honest native support; adding a point there would rely on the expected count or interpolation. The proposal therefore remains under review rather than accepted.

series.comment: All 48 proposed CO2 rows were checked against panel.png. Main-panel marker coverage is supported where centres are separable, but the dense low-pressure strip has one unresolved fused-marker slot and cannot be certified complete from native pixels.

uncertainties: The dense CO2 strip in native panel pixels approximately [148,68,192,497] contains overlapping/fused blue rings; one supplied unresolved slot remains indecisive.
The source/spec expected-count estimate of about 65 is not treated as evidence. No additional point was added solely to reach that count.
No estimated operations are present. The inset and the red N2 77K series are excluded from the CO2 coordinate inventory.
